Learned counsel for applicant submits that a perusal of the medical examination report of the victim shows that no sign of any injury has been found on the external and internal examination of the victim.

He has further drawn attention of the court towards the mental condition which has been found well oriented and level of consciousness is also found conscious and oriented thus, the statement in the F.I.R. that victim was mentally retarded is false.

He next submits that in the statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the place of occurrence has been alleged at Kujraya while giving statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the place of occurrence is near Beekha tree and in the statement before the trial court, the statement is near a Chakki.
therefore, the improvement has been made at every stage and place of occurrence has been changed by the victim.

He has further drawn attention of the court towards the statement of the victim given before the court where she has admitted that both the statements given under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. have been made by her as told by her mother.
The statement of the victim does not inspire confidence, there is no other corroborative evidence.
Applicant has no criminal antecedent and is languishing in jail since 03.08.2021.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the bail prayer and have submitted that victim is minor aged about 14 years old and has supported the prosecution version in her statement.

On due consideration to the submissions advanced, perusal of the record as also the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, applicant is languishing in jail since 03.08.2021 and further place of occurrence has been changed by the victim at every stage, there is no apprehension of tampering with the evidence, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Mohit Yadav be released on bail in aforesaid case crime number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court concerned with the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.

(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
